paper.title: Detecting Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Semantic-level Internal Reasoning Graph

verdict.required_name: SIRG official-code-structure transfer, Llama-2-7B teacher-forced common replay

method_identity.target: RAG faithfulness hallucination relative to supplied context
method_identity.trace_model: full-BF16 Llama-2-7B-chat for the common replay migration
method_identity.fragmentation: newline then spaCy sentence splitting; minimum 5 characters
method_identity.substantive_extraction: frozen official-code union of noun_spacy, entity_spacy, verb_stan, noun_stan and negations
method_identity.graph_target_pool: mean absolute relevance over mapped substantive target tokens, with all-target-token fallback
method_identity.graph_source_pool: maximum relevance over source-fragment token positions
method_identity.linearization: Context i plus source fragment plus contribution score rounded to two decimals; earlier answer fragments prefixed Previous Generate:
method_identity.discriminator: AlignScore-base RoBERTa-base pooled output, dropout 0.1, linear binary head

training.checkpoint_selection: maximum validation fragment F1 at native p(risk)>0.5, once per epoch

paper_code_conflicts: Paper says Adam and 100 iterations; code uses AdamW and 100 epochs.
Paper describes substantive source-token pooling; code takes maximum over every token in each source sentence.
Code writes noun_stan into the noun_spacy field, dropping spaCy noun chunks from the used union.
Main RAGTruth Llama-13B table reports F1 81.84 while the Top-15 ablation table reports 87.21 and code defaults to Top-15.
Dolly Qwen2.5-7B table reports F1 89.71 while prose reports 89.17.
graph_test.py enumerates answer-ratio alpha values but does not freeze one final alpha.
README and entry scripts disagree on output paths, model branch defaults, filenames and checkpoint identity.
missing_artifacts: original training and evaluation data used by the authors

benchmark_interface.window_definition: 4 original BPE tokens, stride 1, project eligibility geometry
benchmark_interface.fit_internal_split: deterministic label-blind 80/20 split by material-group SHA256 rank
benchmark_interface.fragment_training_label: 1 iff fragment character span overlaps any positive project 4-BPE window; otherwise 0
benchmark_interface.fragment_to_window: maximum frozen SIRG fragment risk among fragments whose character span overlaps the window; 0.0 if none
benchmark_interface.calibration: window and answer thresholds selected independently on cal by F1, then precision, then higher threshold

common_replay_limitation.reason: Closed generator rows do not expose generation-time internal states.
common_replay_limitation.main_protocol: Teacher-force every fixed answer through the same full-BF16 Llama-2-7B-chat trace model.
common_replay_limitation.claim_forbidden: recovered original GPT-3.5, GPT-4, Mistral or Llama-70B generation-time reasoning

key_differences: NF4 replay instead of full-BF16 LXT AttenLRP
attention times value-head norm instead of target-token backward relevance
4-BPE logistic regression instead of semantic graph plus fine-tuned AlignScore
source/previous/other, NLI and NLL features instead of Top-15 graph linearization
